findings.evidence: grep locates the replacements in Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:659,1129,671,934,641 and Mathlib/Data/Set/Restrict.lean:54. The new declarations at lines 127–188 already use exactly these replacements as their entire proofs.
findings.fix: Remove these wrappers and use, respectively, Set.range_comp_subset_range r f, hr.range_comp f, Set.range_domRestrict f s, Set.range_eq_empty f, Set.range_unique, and Set.range_comp for both composition laws; unfold realizedFunctions when rewriting.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:884 states preimage_singleton_nonempty and :143 states preimage_comp. Basic.lean:72 and :137 use those declarations verbatim.

summary: Several public comparison lemmas duplicate existing Mathlib declarations up to definitional unfolding, creating an unnecessary parallel API.
